/* TB_GZQO_v1_0 — GENERATED by TrialBox criteria-compiler from Criterion IR (GZQO v1.0.0-bfe7e29c1).
   Deterministic template output (SPEC §6.2); never edited by hand or produced by an LLM. */
/* GZQO-INC-01 (inclusion): Male or female participants aged 18 years or older at screening. */
/* GZQO-INC-02 (inclusion): Diagnosis of gout according to the 2015 ACR/EULAR gout classification criteria. */
/* GZQO-INC-03 (inclusion): Body mass index (BMI) ≥27 kg/m² at screening. */
/* GZQO-INC-04 (inclusion): Serum urate ≥6.8 mg/dL at screening, or ≥6.0 mg/dL if receiving urate-lowering therapy. */
/* GZQO-INC-06 (inclusion): Receiving stable urate-lowering therapy for at least 3 months (continuous within the past 6 months, gaps ≤30 days). */
/* GZQO-INC-08 (inclusion): Estimated GFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² (CKD-EPI 2021) at screening. */
/* GZQO-INC-09 (inclusion): Followed at the rheumatology or metabolism clinic with at least one visit in the past 12 months. */
/* GZQO-EXC-02 (exclusion): History of acute or chronic pancreatitis. */
/* GZQO-EXC-03 (exclusion): Personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2. */
/* GZQO-EXC-04 (exclusion): Use of a GLP-1 receptor agonist or GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist within 90 days before screening. */
/* GZQO-EXC-05 (exclusion): Prior or planned bariatric surgery. */
/* GZQO-EXC-07 (exclusion): Malignancy within the past 5 years, except non-melanoma skin cancer. */
/* GZQO-EXC-08 (exclusion): Pregnant or breastfeeding, or positive pregnancy test. */
/* GZQO-EXC-09 (exclusion): Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure ≥160 mmHg) at screening. */
/* GZQO-EXC-10 (exclusion): Myocardial infarction or stroke within 90 days before screening. */
/* GZQO-EXC-13 (exclusion): ALT >3× upper limit of normal (>120 U/L) at screening. */
